title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Add token-level KV cache hit/miss metrics, token cost and latency breakdowns by route/model/tenant; new Grafana dashboard with drilldowns; tuned alert rules to reduce noise and detect sustained regressions.
description:
Motivation: We need better token-level observability to understand per-request cost and latency contributions, and to correlate KV cache behavior with token generation efficiency. This PR adds Prometheus metrics for KV cache hits/misses, token-level cost accounting, improved latency histograms, tracing spans for critical stages (kv lookup, model forward, batching), a Grafana dashboard, and tuned alert rules to reduce noise from transient spikes.

What changed (summary):
- telemetry/prometheus: new metrics redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_tokens_generated_total, redwood_token_cost_usd_total, and redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket (histogram). Labels: route, model, tenant_id, quantization_profile.
- runtime/kv_cache: emit hit/miss counters and latency spans around lookups; ensure low-overhead path when metrics are disabled.
- pkg/tracing/instrumentation.go: add spans inference.kv_lookup and inference.model_forward, include kv cache tags.
- observability/grafana/token_level_dashboard.json: new dashboard with panels for KV hit rate, token cost breakdown, token latency p50/p90/p95, and per-route top-N cost contributors.
- deploy/monitoring/alerts.yaml: tuned alerting rules to use rate() over 5m with sustained evaluation windows and added deduplication for tenant-scoped alerts. Reduced sensitivity for short-lived bursts; added fallback alert when p95 latency is > X for 10m.
- docs/observability.md: documented new metrics, recommended dashboards, and runbook for investigating elevated token cost.
- tests/observability: unit tests for metric registration and end-to-end smoke test that exercises metrics with a small canary workload.

Testing and CI: Unit tests + telemetry integration tests included. Initial CI run failed linting for a formatting issue in observability/grafana/token_level_dashboard.json; fixed in follow-up commit and re-ran CI. All checks passed (unit, integration, lint, grafana-lint). Load-tested the metrics emission in perf-canary (low overhead observed ~0.5% CPU at 5k rps on dedicated replica).

Rollout plan: Merge to main and deploy telemetry changes behind runtime feature flag telemetry.token_level_metrics=false by default. Gradual enable for staging -> canary -> prod; create a rollout job to enable for 5% of traffic, measure metrics cardinality and ingestion cost for 24h, then increase.

Backward compatibility and performance: Metrics are additive and behind an opt-in flag; instrumentation path uses lightweight counters/buckets and avoids high-cardinality labels unless enabled. Documented tradeoffs in docs/observability.md.

1) Add prometheus metrics and registration for token-level KPIs
2) Emit KV cache hit/miss counters from runtime/kv_cache
3) Add tracing spans for KV lookup and model forward
4) Grafana dashboard JSON and dashboard provisioning
5) Alert rule tuning and deduplication for tenant-scoped alerts
6) Add unit and e2e telemetry tests
7) Fix lint/formatting for dashboard JSON

discussion:
Marcus Lee: Please ensure we don't add unbounded cardinality on tenant_id by default; can we add a top_n label and a 'cardinality=low' mode?
Ava Chen (author): Agree, metrics default to tenant_id='__masked__' unless telemetry.token_level_cardinality=high is enabled; added top_n_by_cost label and documented.
Priya Nair: What's the expected ingestion cost increase for Prometheus? We should estimate and add to rollout doc.
Ava Chen: Measured ~8-12% increase in ingestion for staging at 5k rps with high-cardinality labels enabled; default (masked) mode is ~0.8%. Added numbers in docs and the Linear ticket.
Diego Alvarez: Alert tuning LGTM, consider using runbook links in alert annotations.
Ava Chen: Added runbook_url annotation and improved alert descriptions.
CI bot: initial checks failed (lint: dashboard JSON formatting) - @ava-chen pushed fixup to normalize dashboard JSON and re-ran CI. All checks passed.
Marcus Lee: Approved. Priya Nair: Approved after docs updated. Diego Alvarez: Approved and merged.
ci_checks_summary: unit: pass, integration: pass, lint: pass (after fix), grafana-lint: pass, e2e-telemetry: pass
notes_for_ops: Feature guarded by telemetry.token_level_metrics=false by default. To enable: set feature flag to true in runtime config and monitor prometheus remote_write ingestion. Use observability/token-level dashboard. If alerts fire, follow docs/observability.md runbook which includes steps to rollback the flag and disable high-cardinality mode.
post_merge_tasks:
1) Create a canary deployment enabling token-level metrics for 5% traffic
2) Monitor cardinality and ingestion cost for 24h
3) If stable, increment to 25% and repeat
4) Announce in #observability when 100% rollout completed
notes: This PR targets long-standing gaps from ENG-1124 (token economics) and ENG-1135 (kv cache visibility). The implementation prioritizes low overhead and opt-in high-cardinality telemetry to balance observability vs cost.
